name: Vampire - Unarmed Strike - Successes
description: Flavor text for successes a legendary

results.text: His strike lands like a blade forged in the fires of damnation, tearing flesh effortlessly.
Bone cracks and blood sprays as his legendary blow connects with bone-crushing force.
The vampire's claws rend through armor like paper, leaving a mortal wound behind.
A guttural snarl escapes his lips as his fist crushes its mark with superhuman strength.
His strike is swift as death itself, leaving no room for mercy or hesitation.
